data.narrative:
Nuclearn.ai is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Bradley Fox and Jerrold Vincent that has raised $10.5M to date. The nuclear energy sector includes 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers, including Fuse Energy, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method here. Using total capital raised ($10.5M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $21M. A peer-median approach was not viable because the narrow filtered peer set in nuclear energy—same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables—fell below the three-datapoint threshold required for statistical reliability, despite the existence of four same-sector peers.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $18M to $24M, with a median of $21M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around both the appropriate stage-progression multiplier in a sector with limited public comparables and the representativeness of the $10M raised as a valuation anchor. Key unknowns include the company's technology differentiation within advanced nuclear, capital efficiency relative to sector peers, and timeline to subsequent funding events that would validate or revise this estimate.
